notes.title: V1.0.0 - RELEASE - New level and improvements
notes.content:
NEW LEVEL
- Added a new level (Waze bank)
- Added a new janitor in the banks maps

FIXES
- Fixed the rotation of some characters when knocked out
- Fixed some input staying down when doing unfocus
- Fixed the trigger for quit level notification when knocked out
- Fixed the win screen (not appearing when healed in the quit level zone)
- Fixed loading background image
- Fixed some keys spawns
- Fixed some hitboxes

IMPROVEMENTS / CHANGES
- Added more cleaning objects on certain maps
- Added some ambience sound

- Fixed raise bar displaying temporarily when knocked out

notes.title: V0.3.0 - New level and improvements
notes.content:
NEW LEVEL
- Added a new office level

IMPROVEMENTS
- Added some lockers where players can hide (normal difficulty only)
- Now when a player hides, entities stop chasing
- Added some 2D maps inside the levels

FIXES
- Fixed interactions issues when knocked out
- Entities now can also open sliding doors
- Fixed some outline of knocked out players being disabled incorrectly

notes.title: V0.2.0 - Improvements and fixes
notes.content:
IMPROVEMENT / CHANGES
- New skins
- Outlined objects are now visible from further away
- Knocked out player can now set objects to be visible behind the walls (for all players)
- Increased by 10% walk and run speed
- Darker ambiance and decreased flashlight intensity
- Added one more medikit by level
- Limited max chase entities speed when playing alone
- Tweaked some UI
- Tweaked some materials

FIXES
- Disabled wrong difficulty info text 
- Fixed shadows issues
- Fixed notification / stat achievement to be trigger too many times when dead
- Disabled UI for cinematic game over
- Fixed prone animation to be correctly on ground
- Fixed some situations where players were no more outlined
